info.title: Sandbox Agent
info.description: HTTP API for Sandbox Agent, a universal runtime for AI coding agents. Provides sandbox filesystem, process, desktop, and configuration management alongside an ACP proxy for agent communication.

get.description:
Returns all currently running ACP proxy server instances with their
bound agent and creation timestamp.

get.summary: Open an SSE stream for an ACP server.
get.description:
Returns a Server-Sent Events stream carrying JSON-RPC envelopes from
the agent process. Requires `Accept: text/event-stream`.

406.description: Client does not accept SSE responses

post.summary: Send a JSON-RPC envelope to an ACP server.
post.description:
Posts a JSON-RPC request or notification to the specified ACP server
instance. The first POST to a new server_id must include the `agent`
query parameter to bind the server to an agent.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Agent id required for first POST

406.description: Client does not accept JSON responses

409.description: ACP server bound to different agent

delete.description: Terminates the ACP proxy server and its associated agent process.

get.description:
Returns all known agents with their installation status, credential
availability, and optionally their version and configuration options.

Returns detailed information for one agent, including installation status,
credential availability, and optionally version and configuration options.

post.description:
Downloads and installs the agent binary and its process wrapper. Returns
the list of installed artifacts and whether the agent was already present.

get.summary: Get an MCP server configuration entry.
get.description:
Reads a single named MCP server entry from the project-scoped
configuration file in the given directory.

put.summary: Create or update an MCP server configuration entry.
put.description:
Writes a named MCP server entry into the project-scoped configuration
file, creating the file and parent directories as needed.

delete.summary: Delete an MCP server configuration entry.
delete.description:
Removes a named MCP server entry from the project-scoped configuration
file.

get.description:
Reads a single named skills entry from the project-scoped configuration
file in the given directory.

put.summary: Create or update a skills configuration entry.
put.description:
Writes a named skills entry into the project-scoped configuration file,
creating the file and parent directories as needed.

delete.description: Removes a named skills entry from the project-scoped configuration file.

get.description: Returns the current text content of the X11 clipboard.

parameters.name: selection
parameters.description: X11 selection name (e.g. "clipboard" or "primary"). Defaults to "clipboard".

post.description: Sets the text content of the X11 clipboard.

get.description:
Performs a health-gated display query against the managed desktop and
returns the current display identifier and resolution.

503.description: Desktop runtime health or display query failed

post.summary: Press and hold a desktop keyboard key.
post.description:
Performs a health-gated `xdotool keydown` operation against the managed
desktop.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

post.description:
Performs a health-gated `xdotool key` operation against the managed
desktop.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

post.description:
Performs a health-gated `xdotool type` operation against the managed
desktop.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

post.description:
Performs a health-gated `xdotool keyup` operation against the managed
desktop.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

post.description:
Launches an application by name on the managed desktop, optionally waiting
for its window to appear.

Performs a health-gated pointer move and click against the managed desktop
and returns the resulting mouse position.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

post.summary: Press and hold a desktop mouse button.
post.description:
Performs a health-gated optional pointer move followed by `xdotool mousedown`
and returns the resulting mouse position.

200.description: Desktop mouse position after button press

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

post.description:
Performs a health-gated drag gesture against the managed desktop and
returns the resulting mouse position.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

post.description:
Performs a health-gated absolute pointer move on the managed desktop and
returns the resulting mouse position.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

get.summary: Get the current desktop mouse position.
get.description: Performs a health-gated mouse position query against the managed desktop.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input check failed

post.description:
Performs a health-gated scroll gesture at the requested coordinates and
returns the resulting mouse position.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

post.description:
Performs a health-gated optional pointer move followed by `xdotool mouseup`
and returns the resulting mouse position.

200.description: Desktop mouse position after button release

502.description: Desktop runtime health or input failed

post.summary: Open a file or URL with the default handler.
post.description: Opens a file path or URL using xdg-open on the managed desktop.

Starts an ffmpeg x11grab recording against the managed desktop and returns
the created recording metadata.

409.description: Desktop runtime is not ready or a recording is already active

post.description:
Stops the active desktop recording and returns the finalized recording
metadata.

get.description: Returns the current desktop recording catalog.
Returns metadata for a single desktop recording.

delete.description: Removes a completed desktop recording and its file from disk.

get.description: Serves the recorded MP4 bytes for a completed desktop recording.

Performs a health-gated full-frame screenshot of the managed desktop and
returns the requested image bytes.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Image format (png, jpeg, or webp). Defaults to png.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Image quality (0-100). Only applies to jpeg and webp formats.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Scale factor for the output image.

parameters.name: showCursor
parameters.description: Whether to include the mouse cursor in the screenshot.

502.description: Desktop runtime health or screenshot capture failed

get.description:
Performs a health-gated screenshot crop against the managed desktop and
returns the requested region image bytes.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Left edge of the capture region in pixels.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Top edge of the capture region in pixels.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the capture region in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the capture region in pixels.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Image format (png, jpeg, or webp). Defaults to png.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Image quality (0-100). Only applies to jpeg and webp formats.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Scale factor for the output image.

parameters.name: showCursor
parameters.description: Whether to include the mouse cursor in the screenshot.

200.description: Desktop screenshot region as image bytes

502.description: Desktop runtime health or screenshot capture failed

post.description:
Lazily launches the managed Xvfb/openbox stack, validates display health,
and returns the resulting desktop status snapshot.

501.description: Desktop API unsupported on this platform

503.description: Desktop runtime could not be started

get.description:
Returns the current desktop runtime state, dependency status, active
display metadata, and supervised process information.

post.description:
Terminates the managed openbox/Xvfb/dbus processes owned by the desktop
runtime and returns the resulting status snapshot.

get.summary: Open a desktop WebRTC signaling session.
get.description:
Upgrades the connection to a WebSocket used for WebRTC signaling between
the browser client and the desktop streaming process. Also accepts mouse
and keyboard input frames as a fallback transport.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: Bearer token alternative for WS auth

409.description: Desktop runtime or streaming session is not ready

post.description: Enables desktop websocket streaming for the managed desktop.

get.description: Returns the current state of the desktop WebRTC streaming session.

post.description: Disables desktop websocket streaming for the managed desktop.

get.description:
Performs a health-gated visible-window enumeration against the managed
desktop and returns the current window metadata.

503.description: Desktop runtime health or window query failed

get.summary: Get the currently focused desktop window.
get.description: Returns information about the window that currently has input focus.

post.description: Brings the specified window to the foreground and gives it input focus.
Moves the specified window to the given position.
Resizes the specified window to the given dimensions.

get.description:
Returns the immediate children of the specified directory, including
file names, sizes, types, and last-modified timestamps.

delete.description:
Removes the entry at the given path. For directories, set `recursive`
to true to remove contents recursively.

get.description: Returns the raw bytes of the file at the given path.

put.description:
Writes raw bytes to the file at the given path, creating parent
directories as needed. Returns the resolved path and bytes written.

post.description:
Creates the directory at the given path, including any missing parent
directories.

post.summary: Move or rename a file or directory.
post.description:
Moves the entry from one path to another. Set `overwrite` to true to
replace an existing destination.

get.description:
Returns the type, size, and last-modified timestamp for the entry at
the given path.

post.summary: Upload files as a tar archive.
post.description:
Accepts a tar archive body, extracts its contents into the destination
directory, and returns the list of extracted paths.

get.description:
Returns a simple health status indicating the service is running and
reachable.

Returns a list of all processes (running and exited) currently tracked
by the runtime, sorted by process ID.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Filter processes by owner (user, desktop, or system).

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

post.description:
Spawns a new process with the given command and arguments. Supports both
pipe-based and PTY (tty) modes. Returns the process descriptor on success.

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

get.description:
Returns the current runtime configuration for the process management API,
including limits for concurrency, timeouts, and buffer sizes.

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

post.description:
Replaces the runtime configuration for the process management API.
Validates that all values are non-zero and clamps default timeout to max.

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

post.description:
Executes a command to completion and returns its stdout, stderr, exit code,
and duration. Supports configurable timeout and output size limits.

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

get.summary: Get a single process by ID.
get.description:
Returns the current state of a managed process including its status,
PID, exit code, and creation/exit timestamps.

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

delete.description:
Removes a stopped process from the runtime. Returns 409 if the process
is still running; stop or kill it first.

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

post.description:
Sends data to a process's stdin (pipe mode) or PTY writer (tty mode).
Data can be encoded as base64, utf8, or text. Returns 413 if the decoded
payload exceeds the configured `maxInputBytesPerRequest` limit.

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

post.description:
Sends SIGKILL to the process and optionally waits up to `waitMs`
milliseconds for the process to exit before returning.

parameters.name: waitMs
parameters.description: Wait up to N ms for process to exit

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

get.description:
Returns buffered log entries for a process. Supports filtering by stream
type, tail count, and sequence-based resumption. When `follow=true`,
returns an SSE stream that replays buffered entries then streams live output.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only entries with sequence greater than this

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

post.description:
Sends SIGTERM to the process and optionally waits up to `waitMs`
milliseconds for the process to exit before returning.

parameters.name: waitMs
parameters.description: Wait up to N ms for process to exit

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

post.description:
Sets the PTY window size (columns and rows) for a tty-mode process and
sends SIGWINCH so the child process can adapt.

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

get.summary: Open an interactive WebSocket terminal session.
get.description:
Upgrades the connection to a WebSocket for bidirectional PTY I/O. Accepts
`access_token` query param for browser-based auth (WebSocket API cannot
send custom headers). Streams raw PTY output as binary frames and accepts
JSON control frames for input, resize, and close.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: Bearer token alternative for WS auth

400.description: Invalid websocket frame or upgrade request

501.description: Process API unsupported on this platform

windows.description: Current visible windows (included when the desktop is active).
